clause: Landlord may increase monthly rent upon thirty (30) days' written notice, with no cap stated in this agreement.

strict.reason: The clause allows unlimited rent increases, potentially costing the reader money.

generous.reason: The clause allows the landlord to raise the rent without any cap, directly increasing the tenant’s monthly payment.

adjudicator.plain: The clause permits the landlord to raise the monthly rent at any time, provided they give thirty (30) days' written notice, and there is no limit on how high the increase can be.
adjudicator.action: Ask the landlord to provide a written notice of the proposed rent increase and request a written explanation of the amount and the basis for the increase before the 30‑day period expires.
